detailed_descriptions.en: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot and destroy the city. A mysterious giant destruction robot is on the hunt for prey, and the streetlights of one unfortunate military dictatorship have just appeared on its deadly radar. The robot’s controls are in your hands. Your goal is simple: cause as many casualties as possible before time runs out. Dazzling shops, endless streams of cars swarming like ants, skyscrapers reaching for the sky... It’s time to show that arrogant city what fear really means. Take control of the giant robot, crush the army, and leave the city in ruins. Enhance your robot with over 300 upgrades Every time you destroy a city, you will be paid in proportion to the casualties caused. Use the upgrade tree to make your robot bigger, faster, and stronger! Develop special weapons Beyond its massive size and destructive power, the giant robot comes equipped with a variety of special weapons. Trigger earthquakes, fire automatic lasers and artillery shells, and unleash a beam of pure destruction. Develop new weapons and reduce even more buildings to ashes. Meet more new robots What’s better than one giant robot? Two giant robots. No matter how powerful a robot is, a sprawling city is too big to demolish alone in the time you have. Unlock new support robots through upgrades. Each has its own personality and abilities. With their help, bring the city to its final end together!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot and destroy the city.

A mysterious giant destruction robot is on the hunt for prey, and the streetlights of one unfortunate military dictatorship have just appeared on its deadly radar. The robot’s controls are in your hands. Your goal is simple: cause as many casualties as possible before time runs out. Dazzling shops, endless streams of cars swarming like ants, skyscrapers reaching for the sky... It’s time to show that arrogant city what fear really means. Take control of the giant robot, crush the army, and leave the city in ruins.

Enhance your robot with over 300 upgrades

Every time you destroy a city, you will be paid in proportion to the casualties caused. Use the upgrade tree to make your robot bigger, faster, and stronger!

Develop special weapons

Beyond its massive size and destructive power, the giant robot comes equipped with a variety of special weapons. Trigger earthquakes, fire automatic lasers and artillery shells, and unleash a beam of pure destruction. Develop new weapons and reduce even more buildings to ashes.

Meet more new robots

What’s better than one giant robot? Two giant robots. No matter how powerful a robot is, a sprawling city is too big to demolish alone in the time you have. Unlock new support robots through upgrades. Each has its own personality and abilities. With their help, bring the city to its final end together!
